audit.why: Both layers read Skill on all seven rows and the packet levelChart agrees; both are 1050-1175 range skillshot mages with no mobility, so no stage has a structural owner. Nothing in either kit justifies moving a row.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] had 3 entries where 4 are expected, and nothing covered Brand's Pillar of Flame max — the point where his stun setup becomes repeatable.
audit.why: Pillar of Flame drops from 10s to 8s across its ranks and is the ability that applies Blaze so Sear can stun; that cadence, not an item, is his lane spike.
audit.corrected: Added spikes[3] for the W-max window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeats that Sear only stuns when you are ablaze but never gives a cooldown, and never states that Prismatic Barrier's job here is the Pillar-into-Sear window specifically.
audit.why: Sear is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s and stuns only against a target carrying Blaze; Pillar of Flame (10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, 900 range) is the applier; Conflagration is only 625 range, so his stun chain needs him to step in. Pyroclasm is 100/90/80s at 750 range and prioritises stacking Blaze to max.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, enemyWin and breakdown.carry now carry the real numbers and the burn-before-stun dependency.

audit.why: It is the field that holds real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with Sear 8s/6s, Pillar of Flame 10s/8s and Pyroclasm 100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim under "W-shield his combo on the tell"; dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string verbatim under "Waste the root on chip spacing" (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED x2).
audit.why: Both bodies answered a different question than their titles asked.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to their own titles using Prismatic Barrier's 12s and Light Binding's flat 10s.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flags "Lux Light Binding" in spikes[0].text as a probable wrong name. It is not — Light Binding is Lux's real Q. False positive; no edit made.

audit.whatIsWrong: lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED: the body was the tradeBad string verbatim under an unrelated title.
audit.why: An earlier proposal targeted these same fields but its replacement text overshot the +/-10% length rule, so apply-proposals dropped the edit and the defect survived on disk.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to the same meaning inside the length budget, grounded in real ability names and cooldowns from champ-data/_kits: dontsFull[2].d.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Prismatic Barrier like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sear (Q): 8s at rank 1, 6s at rank 5, and it only stuns if Blaze is already on you — clean of the burn, it is just damage. - Pillar of Flame (W) is 10s down to 8s, the setup he needs first. - Pyroclasm is 100s at rank 1: after it, he is a farmer.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, weave the passive auto, and keep Q visibly loaded — the chip is free and the root threat does the zoning.
edits.after: Prismatic Barrier is 12s at rank 1 — spend it on the Pillar-into-Sear window, not on a burn tick, and the stun half of his combo does nothing.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown and facing the dive with an empty root slot — Lux without the binding banked is everyone's favorite snack.
edits.after: Light Binding is your only stop button on a 10s cooldown — throw it for chip and Pyroclasm bounces through you unanswered.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Brand wins by putting Blaze on you first so Sear stuns, then bouncing Pyroclasm off you from 750 range.

edits.before: Carry through the root-laser pipeline — one binding per fight, converted at screen range; your job is owning the geometry that makes it land.
edits.after: Carry by keeping Blaze off you: with no burn on you his Q cannot stun, and a Lux who never gets stunned lasers him from 3340 units all game.
Pillar of Flame maxed drops to an 8-second cooldown, so Brand can keep Blaze applied and his Sear stun becomes available on nearly every trade.

notes: packet.suspectNames flags "Lux Light Binding" as a probable wrong ability name — it is correct (Lux Q is Light Binding) and was left alone. Level chart is Skill across all seven rows in both layers and in the packet, and the kits give no reason to move a row, so no chart edits. Left `ahead`, breakdown.wave and breakdown.late templated: both champions are immobile ranged mages and I could not ground a Brand-specific replacement without inventing an interaction — the Blaze-detonation timing (3 stacks, 2 second fuse) is in Riot's text but I could not verify whether it applies spell effects to Lux's shield or interacts with her passive, so I did not write it. QA re-scope: previous edits to dontsFull[2].d were rejected for length drift; re-proposed within budget. Cooldowns quoted are Riot per-rank values from the kit files; no spell-shield, cleanse or minion-block behaviour is asserted anywhere, since the kits do not state it.
